newsitem.title: USA: BMW-No decision yet on location of auto plant.
newsitem.headline: BMW-No decision yet on location of auto plant.

text.p: German carmaker BMW AG on Monday denied earlier reports it planned to build a car plant together with Chrysler in Brazil, saying a decision had yet to be taken on the location of the plant.
BMW chairman Bernd Pischetsrieder also said it was not the case that BMW planned to build a Land Rover factory in Brazil.
Pischetsrieder said the company probably would be setting up a plant in Latin America, but a final decision had yet to be reached on where exactly it would be located.
Earlier, Michael Turwitt, president of BMW's Brazilian unit, said BMW and Chrysler had planned to build an engine factory together, which would be located in Brazil.
Turwitt also said the local unit planned to build a $150 million car plant in Brazil to assemble up to 15,000 Land Rover Defenders by 1998.
